mapper.select: SELECT id,row_number,feedback_source_id,row_status,quality_error_code fail_code,quality_error_summary fail_reason FROM t_import_row WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND record_type='ROW' ORDER BY row_number

SELECT parent_import_row_id,COUNT(*) attachment_count,SUM(final_status='AVAILABLE') available_attachment_count FROM t_import_row WHERE record_type='ATTACHMENT_TASK' AND parent_import_row_id IN #{id} GROUP BY parent_import_row_id
